description: This file implements the ControlModuleService class and related factory functions for managing IPC control modules, including client connection handling, shared memory retrieval, and control registration within the Rialto server IPC framework.

classes.name: ControlModuleService
classes.description: Implements the control module service handling client connections, shared memory access, and control registration for IPC.

classes.name: IControlModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating control module service instances.

classes.name: ControlModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Concrete factory class for creating ControlModuleService instances.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IControlModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new ControlModuleService instance, given playback and control services.

methods.name: ControlModuleService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with playback and control services.

methods.name: ~ControlModuleService
methods.description: Destructor that removes all controls associated with connected clients.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles new client connection, registers the client, and exports the service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection, removes associated controls.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves shared memory file descriptor and size from the playback service.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new client, assigns a control ID, and stores the control.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment requests for control operations.
